items.notes: Built. cis_poam_items table (PATCH_008). renderCISPoam(), cisOpenPoam(), cisSavePoam(), cisExportPoam(). Logo row placeholder in Excel export (row 1) — full logo upload is backlogged.

items.text: Client logo upload for POAM and report exports: allow logo upload in Organisation Manager, stored in Supabase Storage, embedded in Excel/PDF exports at top of document.
CIS assessment PDF/Excel export: produce a formatted report card showing score, IG progress, per-control summary, and gap list — branded Abbott Cyber.
items.notes: Session 28: Excel export (cisExportExcel) now includes Column H 'Comment' populated with existing assessor notes; import (cisParseImportFile + cisImportSave) reads Column H back and saves to cis_safeguard_notes. Word exec report (cisExportReportWord) now embeds radar chart + dot/line trend chart as inline PNG images captured from cisReportRadar and cisReportTrend canvases, plus a page-break section with the full 18-control/153-safeguard detail listing showing each safeguard ID, IG tier, answer (colour-coded), title and description.

items.text: Exec report copy-prompt improvements (all 4 modules): enrich AI prompt with trend delta vs previous run, named improvement and regression areas, and explicit instruction to call out progress by domain.
items.notes: Session 44b: all 4 copy-prompt functions updated — cisCopyReportPrompt (cis.js), aiuCopyReportPrompt (ai_unified.js), nistAiCopyReportPrompt (nist_ai.js), iso42001CopyReportPrompt (iso42001.js). Each now computes: trendDelta (+/-% vs prior date), improvedAreas (CIS Controls / AI domains / NIST functions / ISO clauses that gained), regressedAreas (same for losses). All 3 fields added to prompt data section (TREND DELTA, IMPROVEMENT AREAS, REGRESSION AREAS). Trend instruction updated in each: CIS uses ---TREND--- marker and names improved controls; AI Unified weaves improvement into executive summary instruction; NIST AI + ISO 42001 fully restructured (formatting rules block added, output restructured to KEY FINDINGS + PRIORITY RECOMMENDATIONS markers matching AI Unified quality). Grouping: CIS by ctrl number/name, AI Unified by AI_GROUP_META label, NIST AI by NIST_FN_META label, ISO 42001 by ISO42001_CLAUSE_META label. Delta computed vs immediately preceding chronological run (not latest — handles historical report viewing correctly).

items.notes: Built. cisOpenReport() opens report view, renderCISReport() renders full layout. cisDrawGauge(), cisDrawDonut(), cisDrawReportTrend() draw Canvas charts. cisGenerateReportPrompt() copies data-rich prompt to clipboard. cisSaveCommentary() persists commentary to assessment answers._exec_commentary via PATCH. Commentary parsed from ---CONTROLS---/---TREND---/---GAPS--- delimiters. cisDrawReportTrend() rewritten as proper stacked bar: IG1 bottom (green), IG2 middle (blue), IG3 top (purple); each zone fills from bottom by tier score%; score % label inside each zone; overall score label above bar; now draws with 1+ runs. fmtCommentary() rewritten line-by-line: KEY FINDINGS → navy sub-heading + bullet table (• column); PRIORITY RECOMMENDATIONS → navy sub-heading + numbered navy-cell table (1/2/3); handles AI output with single or double \n, with or without • characters. Radar and trend now drawn fresh on off-screen canvases at export time (not captured from in-page canvas which could be stale). Session 30: Gauge replaced SVG (unreliable in Word) with canvas→PNG — full red→orange→amber→lime→green spectrum track, needle, hub circle. Report title now dynamic: 'CIS IG2 Assessment — Executive Report'. IG progress table: N/A column added, gap count excludes N/A, score denominator excludes N/A. AI prompt: 80% advancement threshold logic — ≥80% recommends advancing to next IG; <80% recommends consolidating; exec summary instructed to close with next-year scope recommendation. JS script tags: ?v=20260618b cache-bust added to all modules.

items.text: CIS assessment form: IG filter bar (All / IG1 / IG2 / IG3) to narrow visible safeguards by implementation group tier.

items.text: CIS gap report: dedicated view listing all unanswered or 'No' safeguards for the selected IG goal, sorted by control group, with recommended remediation priority.

items.notes: Session 36. cisIsYes() helper (a === 'yes' || a === 'cc') replaces === 'yes' checks in cisCalcScore(), cisIgProgress(), cisQuickCalcScore(), and exec report scoring loops. sections.title: Tabletop — Multiplayer / Remote Participant Engine
sections.description: Jackbox-style session joining: facilitator generates a session code, participants join via link on any device, select their role, and receive role-filtered injects in real time. No accounts required for participants.

items.text: Session host: vCISO creates a session and receives a unique 6-character session code (e.g. CYBER4)
Join link: participants navigate to a URL and enter the session code to join — no account or login required
Role selection screen: participant sees available roles for the session, selects one, enters their name — role is locked once taken
Role capacity: each role can only be claimed by one participant — late joiners see remaining open roles only
Waiting room: participants see who has joined and which roles are filled while facilitator prepares to launch
Facilitator lobby view: see all connected participants, their roles, and connection status before launching
Role-filtered inject delivery: when facilitator releases an inject, each participant sees only their role-specific information on their device
Participant response input: each role submits their response and criticality rating from their own device
Facilitator sees all responses in real time: dashboard shows which roles have responded and which are pending per inject
Facilitator-only view: facilitator notes and correct criticality are never shown on participant screens
Breach declaration: IC and Exec Sponsor co-sign from their own devices — both must confirm before breach is logged
Session persistence: if a participant disconnects and rejoins with the same code and role, their session state is restored
Session expiry: sessions auto-close after exercise completion or after a configurable idle period (e.g. 4 hours)
AAR available to all participants post-exercise: shareable read-only link to the After Action Report
Mobile-responsive participant view: join and participate fully from a phone or tablet

sections.title: Governance — Application Inventory and Vendor Directory
sections.description: Application inventory with risk/BCDR/IR classification, and vendor directory with criticality, contract tracking, and BCDR/IR contacts. Vendor Directory links to TPRA assessments.

items.text: Application Inventory scaffold — list view of all business applications. Fields: app name, description, business owner, hosting type (SaaS/Cloud/On-Prem/Hybrid), status (Active/Decommissioned/Under Review), vendor/supplier, authentication method (MFA enforced, SSO), data classification (PII, payment, health, IP, confidential), date added, last reviewed.

Application risk and criticality — criticality rating per app (Critical/High/Medium/Low) with rationale. Risk level derived from criticality + data classification. Regulatory scope flag. Displayed as sortable/filterable badges on list view.

Application BCDR classification — per-app BCDR fields: recovery priority (Tier 1/2/3), RTO, RPO, backup method, dependencies (other apps or vendors), BCDR owner contact. Summary view of Tier 1 apps for exec reporting.

Application IR classification — per-app IR fields: in-scope for IR (yes/no), IR priority tier, key technical contact, vendor IR contact, escalation path, last incident date. IR priority auto-suggested from criticality + data classification. Used to pre-populate IR runbooks in tabletop exercises.

Vendor Directory scaffold — list view of all vendors. Fields: vendor name, product/service, website, category (Cloud Infrastructure/SaaS/Managed Services/Professional Services/Hardware/Telecom/Other), primary contact name and email, status (Active/Inactive/Under Review), date added, last reviewed.

Vendor criticality and risk tier — per-vendor: business criticality (Critical/High/Moderate/Low) with rationale, risk tier (mirrors TPRA), data access types (PII, payment, health, IP, infrastructure), jurisdiction, data residency. Certifications held (SOC 2 Type I/II, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, PCI DSS, HIPAA BAA, CSA STAR). Last TPRA assessment date with link to TPRA record if one exists.

Vendor contract and compliance tracking — per-vendor: contract renewal date (90/30 day banner warnings), SLA terms summary, liability and insurance coverage notes, NDA in place, DPA in place, right to audit clause. Dashboard widget showing vendors with renewals in next 90 days.

Vendor BCDR and IR contacts — per-vendor BCDR: in BCDR plan (yes/no), BCDR dependency tier, alternative vendor or workaround documented. Per-vendor IR: 24/7 IR contact name and phone, incident notification SLA (hours), breach notification clause in contract, last confirmed IR contact date. Used to pre-populate vendor notification checklist in tabletop exercises.
